To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the E2 transition probabilities for the yrast levels of the πh11 /2 band in the nucleus 129La have been measured for the first time and that the core quasi-particles coupling model is able to reproduce well the observed E2 transitions in the nucleus 130La.

(i) the E2 transition strengths in 129La are in good agreement with the core quasi-particles coupling model predictions using a phenomenological Ba core and (ii) the rigid rotor model for the Ba core is too simplified and should be modified to account for deformation of the core.
the E2 transition probabilities in 129La have been measured for the first time and that they agree with the predictions based on the experimental deformation parameters of the core nucleus 128Ba.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the determination of the E2 transition strengths between yrast states of 129La.
the properties of the πh11 /2 neutron band in the 129La, 131La and 133La nuclei.
the study of E2 transition strengths in the decoupling region of 129La nucleus, which is of interest in connection with the shape coexistence phenomenon.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the core-quasi-particle coupling model is able to predict the properties of the decoupled πh11/ 2 band in 129La, provided that the core is properly described.
the core quasi-particles coupling model is a useful tool to describe the properties of the yrast band of odd-A nuclei.
the E2 transition probability in the 129La decoupled band is in reasonable agreement with the predictions of the core quasi particle-coupling model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the E2 transition probabilities in 129La are consistent with a rigid-rotor core coupled with a single particle in the πh11 /2 orbital.
the E2 transition probabilities in La nuclei are sensitive to the deformation of the core nuclei.
the core quasi-particles model is a good approximation to the 129La system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is necessary to take the core deformation into account in the theoretical description of the E2 transition probabilities in nuclei with deformed cores.
the E2 transition probability in the yrast band of 129La can be reproduced by a simple core quasi-particle-coupling model if the core is treated as a deformed nucleus.
the core model is not able to predict the E2 transition strengths of the decoupled bands in 129La.
